description.en: The key document number, such as the order ID.
The type of the document number, such as order.

description.zh:
电话类型，有以下枚举：
1：呼入
2：呼出
description.en:
The call type. Valid values:
1: inbound call
2: outbound call.

description.zh:
挂断原因，有以下枚举：
1.转人工导致的结束
2.未转人工在机器人阶段结束
3.用户主动挂断电话
4.机器人主动挂断电话
5.网络异常原因导致的挂断电话
description.en:
The reason why the call is hung up. Valid values:
1: The call ends because it is transferred to a human agent.
2: The call ends during the robot phase without being transferred to a human agent.
3: The user actively hangs up the call.
4: The robot actively hangs up the call.
5: The call is hung up due to a network exception.

description.zh: json，上游系统的业务信息等，如机器人实例等信息
description.en: The business information from the upstream system in JSON format, such as robot instance information.

description.zh: 发起方号码-用户手机号码、客服坐席号码、机器号码等
description.en: The phone number of the caller, such as the mobile phone number of the user, the seat number of the customer service representative, or the robot number.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.

description.zh: 通话接通时间，呼入就等同于gmt_creae，呼出就是用户接通时间
description.en: The time when the call is connected. For inbound calls, this is the same as gmt_create. For outbound calls, this is the time when the user answers the call.
The URL of the recording file.
The session ID of the robot.

description.zh: 接听方号码-用户手机号码、客服坐席号码、机器号码等
description.en: The phone number of the callee, such as the mobile phone number of the user, the seat number of the customer service representative, or the robot number.

description.zh: 从上游系统带来的用户信息，json格式记录
description.en: The user information from the upstream system, in JSON format.
